name: Oxabolone cipionate

card.summary: Obscure injectable 19-nor steroid ester once marketed in Europe as Steranabol; almost nothing is published about it.
card.aka: Oxabolone cypionate, Steranabol Depo, Steranabol Ritardo, FI-5852
card.note: Very thin literature; one case report links the parent compound to mucosal hyperpigmentation.

quick.overview:
Oxabolone cipionate is a long-acting injectable ester of oxabolone (4-hydroxy-19-nortestosterone), a nandrolone-type anabolic steroid. It was marketed in Europe under the names Steranabol Depo and Steranabol Ritardo.

Very little has been published on it. No clinical or appearance studies were found.
quick.mechanism: It is a prodrug of oxabolone, given by intramuscular injection. Published sources do not describe its pharmacology or potency in detail.
quick.risks: The only indexed report found is a 1995 dermatology paper on mucosal hyperpigmentation due to oxabolone. Little else is documented.

lead: Oxabolone cipionate (also spelled cypionate) is a synthetic, injected anabolic-androgenic steroid of the 19-nortestosterone (nandrolone) group. It is the C17-beta cypionate ester of oxabolone, which means the body converts it to oxabolone, and it carried the developmental code FI-5852. It has been marketed in Europe as Steranabol Depo and Steranabol Ritardo. [1][2]

Anabolic steroids of the nandrolone family are discussed in bodybuilding circles for building muscle, and oxabolone cipionate sits in that family; it is an obscure member that appears mainly in historical drug lists. A 2006 T Nation post, for instance, expresses a wish that someone would produce it as a 'stealth' injectable. [3]

Published information is sparse. The one indexed medical report is a 1995 letter in Acta Dermato-Venereologica describing mucosal hyperpigmentation attributed to oxabolone. [4] Oxabolone itself, the parent compound, was never marketed, and it is on the World Anti-Doping Agency's prohibited list. [2]

chain: Injected ester is converted to oxabolone, an androgen-receptor agonist
Anabolic steroids of this class are used in physique sports to promote muscle
angle.text: As a nandrolone-family anabolic steroid, oxabolone cipionate belongs to the class used for muscle mass. There is almost no published human data on this particular compound, so what is known comes from the compound class and drug references.

paras: Oxabolone cipionate has the formula C26H38O4 and is a 3-cyclopentylpropanoate ester of 4-hydroxy-19-nortestosterone. Related compounds include clostebol, norclostebol, formestane and 4-hydroxytestosterone. [1] Wikipedia's oxabolone article lists methylhydroxynandrolone and oxymesterone as structural relatives. [2]

It is a prodrug of oxabolone, given by intramuscular injection, and is classed with androgens, anabolic steroids and androgen esters (ATC code A14AB03). [1] Oxabolone is an androgen receptor agonist. [2]
Drug references cited by Wikipedia, including Index Nominum and The Dictionary of Drugs, list it as marketed in Europe, while the parent oxabolone was never marketed. [1][2]
On bodybuilding forums the compound appears occasionally in lists of historical steroid brands and in wishes for access; a 2006 T Nation member said he had always wished someone would make it. [3]

A 1995 letter in Acta Dermato-Venereologica by Drago and colleagues is indexed as a case report of mucosal hyperpigmentation due to oxabolone, in an adult woman; the record does not give further detail. [4]
No studies found. The only indexed human report is the case report of mucosal hyperpigmentation. [4]
